superseded_run.classification: Superseded by the following review-driven test-fix push; cancelled before public gate execution.
superseded_run.gate_verdict_scope: No component, Linux, PCI or A77 gate verdict was produced by this cancelled run. It is neither a hardware failure verdict nor a pass.

superseding_commit.purpose: Wait for a previously asserted SYS_NOC_CPUSS software vote to clear after the second asynchronous reset; the generic PLL reset marker was already zero.
superseding_commit.origin: The commit message records that the test-only race was found during independent review.

cancellation_attribution.evidence: Both runs use the same branch and workflow. The correcting push started at 12:03:19Z; the prior run completed as cancelled at 12:03:36Z. The old board log reports cancellation and its gate steps are skipped.
cancellation_attribution.inference: The supersession classification follows the configured same-ref concurrency cancellation and run chronology; the REST conclusion itself is only cancelled.

remaining_acceptance_boundaries: This receipt does not assess the separate production-kernel/full-native-DT rerun.
No Android userspace boot or complete hardware-equivalence verdict is established by these public CI gates.
GCC coverage validates the digital SYS_NOC_CPUSS vote/parent/halt contract and same-binary migration, not all critical fabric parents or old-to-new behavioral compatibility.
GPU GDSC request/status and reset checks do not establish Adreno execution or display output.
SMEM reference fixture tests do not establish native SBL capture, remote firmware services or guest-driver execution.
Archive upload identities do not substitute for downloading and hashing individual executable files.
